source: User-approved one-laptop presentation: two CPU roles and three concurrent GPU workers share one Iris Xe. Equal base work units with GPU weights 1.5/1/.5. Synthetic total 500kWh inherited from old 300+200 lab, divided once among five logical quotas; NOT measured heat. Abstract case 0.8kWh/job-hour retained commitment. Four Blender threads per process, at most 12 in GPU phase; CPU stages do not overlap frame phase. Admission settings are not OS/driver quotas or promised utilization. User-approved verification/reuse of unchanged recipe/build scenes.
gpu_heat_need_source: ADR 0068: GPU weights 1.5/1/.5 are heat NEED, not an hourly allowance. Each run's frames are split by weight (48 -> 24/16/8) and each GPU node's heat demand is its share of the current run (frames x frame_heat_kwh) plus heat it already committed this hour. Unchanged heat-first placement then fills nodes in proportion to need; need starts again with every run. Synthetic lab input, NOT measured heat. CPU roles keep their hourly allowance.
